content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; a medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted without changing CO-197. No supported diagnosis correction is available, and a contractual authorization denial cannot properly be shifted to the patient merely because deductible remains. With the payer path exhausted and no secondary or collectible patient liability established, the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
